query:
insert into DetectedReqTraces (
                        last_collect_nr,
                        req_id,
                        file_hash,
                        line
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (req_id, file_hash, line)
                    do update set
                        last_collect_nr = excluded.last_collect_nr
